topics.name: DWH Dual-Version Transition
topics.purpose: Define bounded coexistence of old/new schema versions during migration, including read/write compatibility, cutover criteria and prohibition of indefinite ambiguous dual semantics.

semantics.version_rule: Each record/access path resolves an explicit schema version during transition.
semantics.read_rule: Dual-read adapters/projections are explicit and version-aware.
semantics.write_rule: Dual-write is allowed only through an explicit declared transformation/transaction profile.
semantics.bound_rule: Dual-version transition is bounded by explicit completion/expiry criteria.
semantics.legacy_rule: Legacy version does not remain active by accident after cutover.
semantics.authority_rule: Version compatibility does not expand read/write authorization.

invariants.rule: Schema evolution is an explicit versioned migration between exact schema identities/versions with validated compatibility and data transformation provenance; runtime/file order never silently changes active data meaning.

hard_gates.condition: cutover based only on clock time without criteria
legacy remains indefinitely active by default

references.purpose: Dual-write consistency uses explicit transaction semantics.
